name: macOS and Windows builds in the tool release pipelines
body: Dean (2026-11-17): the release pipelines for Nox, Nyx, Chaos, Cosmos and Mist only offered Linux x86-64. Add macOS arm64, macOS Intel and Windows x86-64 builds to the same vX.Y.Z and rolling releases, as a matrix with per-platform tarballs and checksums. Linux stays the gate; macOS and Windows are non-blocking until they pass, because Windows (clang-cl) may need real porting work in each repo. A dry-run input builds and tests every platform without publishing. Report per repo what blocks each platform.
acceptance_criteria: Each pipeline builds on linux-x86_64, macos-arm64, macos-x86_64 and windows-x86_64
Each platform that passes its tests publishes a tarball, manifest and sha256 into the vX.Y.Z and rolling releases
A failing macOS or Windows build does not block the Linux release
What blocks each failing platform is recorded per repo
